long_biography.plain_text:
The Charalambos & Elena Pattihis Foundation gave Eleni Koulouteri Pattihis a permanent platform for philanthropy when she established it with her husband in 2020. Their programme focuses on social welfare, education and culture. It has funded families facing poverty, contributed to wildfire recovery and formed partnerships with local charities.

Pattihis also helped turn pharmaceutical heritage into a public institution. The foundation opened the Takis Pattichis Museum of Industrial Pharmacy in Limassol in 2022. The free venue presents machinery, laboratory equipment and methods behind medicine production in Cyprus. Her wider business responsibilities include directorships in the property holding companies Lima Holdings and Montserrat Holdings and the financial-management firms Skytrust and Marilite.
